summary: Karpathy describes musing about testing Opus 5 by giving it the opening paragraph of The Lord of the Rings with a 1M token budget, as an idea for generalizing LLM evaluation beyond simple prompts.

practices.reason: The author floats a personal idea for a new style of LLM test but gives no methodology or result, so it is not yet a transferable evaluation technique.
